job_title: AI Developer Intern - Implementation Test Automation

company_info.industry_info: Human Capital Management (HCM) Software; Dayforce develops an AI-powered people platform for HR, payroll, time, talent management, planning, and analytics across various industries
company_info.recent_news: Dayforce released new capabilities in February 2026 focusing on Flex Work and contingent labor management, and May 2026 release focused on labor cost analytics and workforce cost controls. Company continues to expand AI features across their platform.
company_info.company_culture: Glassdoor rating: 3.7/5 stars (2,947 reviews). Mixed but generally positive culture. Employees highlight: collaborative and supportive teams, excellent work-life balance, remote work flexibility, unlimited PTO, and inclusive atmosphere. Some concerns noted about USA office environments with focus on billable hours and potential silos in some departments. Overall, 69% of employees would recommend working at Dayforce.
company_info.any_related_information: Dayforce is a publicly-traded HCM company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota with approximately $1.8B in revenue (2024). Company competes with Workday, Oracle, and SAP. The company is actively investing in AI capabilities and implementation automation, which aligns with this internship role focused on AI-driven testing platform development. The internship offers genuine exposure to production software development.
